name: kanban_status_lifecycle
description: Expand kanban_tasks.status CHECK to represent the true task lifecycle: add pr_opened, ci_failed, merge_conflict, changes_requested, failed. Previously these collapsed to in_progress / token_exhausted in _STATE_TO_DB_STATUS, so the board could not distinguish 'PR open, awaiting merge' from 'still coding', and genuine failures masqueraded as (auto-resumable) token_exhausted.
author: icdev-builder
